name: inkling2
description: Inkling 2 Mini (looped MoE, native NVFP4 experts) on Strix Halo: Unsloth GGUFs, vision, tool calls, reasoning control, batched decode and a 1,000,000-token context

releases.notes: Speculative decoding: prompt lookup (on by default; INKLING2_LOOKUP=0 turns it off) and the DSpark drafter via --dspark-model (Unsloth's original 402 MB drafter: the manifest's pinned file, named dspark-Inkling-2-Mini-Q8_0_Old.gguf on Unsloth's main), with an adaptive per-request policy. With default settings a single session's text is identical to plain decoding. One session against plain decoding: lookup alone x1.03 code, x1.18 summaries, x2.26 copy-heavy; with the drafter x1.15 code, x1.51 summaries, x2.23 copy-heavy, x0.96 chat; batches x0.99. Built on Gufo 0.35.0.
Batched decode: routed-expert kernels run shared experts together; 4 sessions 79.6 to 86.2 tok/s, outputs bit-identical to 0.1.1. Built on Gufo 0.35.0; tested in-tree and as an installed module.
First registry release. Built on Gufo 0.35.0; also tested as an installed module.
